shortDescription: Chinese ports handled their busiest week on record ahead of the approaching summit between US President Donald Trump and Xi Jinping, according to Bloomberg.The surge extended a boom in shipments abroad and may indicate exporters were rushing goods out of the country as tariff uncertainty lingered.
